top_performing_topics: Wealth erosion via inflation (FDs/Savings vs. Purchasing Power)
Retail investor traps (Market timing and FOMO)

winning_hook_formulas: The 'Hidden Loss' Formula: [Warning Emoji] + [Common Financial Action] + [Negative Outcome/Loss] (e.g., 'Stop buying Nifty dips before you check this one critical support level')
The 'Status Anxiety' Formula: [Alarm Emoji] + [Personal Financial Goal] + [Why it is failing] (e.g., 'Why your dream home is slipping away while your savings sit still')
script_directives: Strict 20-24 second duration: Cut all fluff; start the value proposition within the first 1.5 seconds.
Negative framing: Focus on what the viewer is losing or risking rather than what they could gain.
High-contrast visuals: Use rapid text overlays that highlight specific numbers or 'trap' keywords to maintain visual engagement.
seo_directives: Use high-intent, contrarian keywords in the title (e.g., 'Trap', 'Stop', 'Secretly', 'Discount').
Limit hashtags to 3-4 highly relevant finance tags (e.g., #StockMarketIndia #PersonalFinance #InvestingTips) to avoid algorithm dilution.
